I have been aware of them for quite a while but I recently found a video of a guy who took some time to do some practical experimentation and research to improve upon their use. By placing the exciter at specific nodal points on the material used along with some strategic weights you can use one exciter to cover a number of frequency resonant points. Using more than one exciter at various nodal points can also help improve their performance and quality. Thin materials work best but you can achieve good results with thicker materials if you choose your mounting points carefully. This video will give you some idea of what you could expect from them.
